description: Problem 4 evidence: live tool calls made by the vibe coder (Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5) through the registered campus-customs MCP server (.mcp.json). Each 'output' is the tool result exactly as returned by the MCP connection, unedited. This is NOT the offline test (mcp_server/verify_tools.py).

session.client: Claude Code desktop app (Code tab), session opened on hw5/

computed.note: Hypothetical arithmetic, not stored facts. Obligations = all open invoices + next rent on each lease. cash_after_all_obligations is what the balance WOULD be if all of them were paid; it is not the current balance (see cash_accounts) and not a cash-flow forecast.

tickets.notes: Needs a tee in size S.

tickets.notes: Email: shop rent due in 2 days.

additional_verification_calls.purpose: Error-handling test requested by Dr. Ryan (Problem 4, follow-up 2), made later in the same session through the same MCP connection. Call 5 uses an invalid SKU; call 6 confirms the connection still works afterward.

calls.result_type: tool error (MCP isError result, returned to the client; the server did not crash)
calls.error_text: Unknown SKU 'INVALID-SKU-TEST'. Known SKUs: CC-HAT-BLUE, CC-HOOD-NAVY, CC-MUG-CREST, CC-TEE-WHITE

limitations: Claude copied each tool result into this file with the Write/Edit tools; the harness did not save it automatically. The file cannot prove its own authenticity. The independent record is this Claude Code session's transcript.

Successful outputs are embedded as JSON values (the same compact text the tools returned), not as quoted strings. The error in call 5 is stored as its text, because the tool returned an error message, not JSON.
No per-call timestamps were recorded; only the session date is given.
The cross_check below is a separate direct-SQL step, not an MCP call.

cross_check.method: Separate step, not an MCP call: direct SQL against data/campus_customs_new.db opened read-only (mode=ro), independent of server.py. Tables read: desk, inventory, pricing, cash_accounts, invoices, vendors, leases, payments, tickets.
cross_check.result: All stored values returned by the four calls match the database: business date 2026-08-31; all 10 inventory rows (qty, location), 4 pricing rows; checking balance 3400 as of 2026-08-31; invoice 501 (vendor 1 Bulldog Print Co, apparel reprint, lead 5 days, 840, due 2026-08-28, open); lease 1 (Chapel Street shop, Elm City Properties, 2400, next due 2026-09-02); 0 payments; tickets 101/102/103 (all open, with matching sku/size/qty/links).
cross_check.computed_fields_checked: days_overdue 3 (08-28 to 08-31), days_until_due 2 (08-31 to 09-02), total_open_obligations 3240 (840 + 2400), cash_after_all_obligations 160 (3400 - 3240, hypothetical only). Arithmetic is correct.
cross_check.database_unchanged: SHA-256 of data/campus_customs.db and data/campus_customs_new.db were identical after the calls (23686a90d698f7fa6f901a3f0a9774db9cbb31e13151c9e5717275f3321f360a); the read-only tools made no changes.
